purpose: Determine whether the existing baseline obeys the clarified ontology and whether a small history-based circulation detector separates measured references.
user_premises: Nodes and relations have no internal physical values or coordinates.
Units of change persist; new units may be born.
Changes follow node hops along existing relations.
New nodes may be produced by local dynamics, potentially depending on degree.
Disconnected components cannot interact through a global fallback.
Weak metastable circulating patterns are an eligible first target; no physical dimension is required.
open_model_choice: User clarification pending: persistent units encoded as graph motifs or as explicit primitive entities with positions. No candidate model will be run before this is settled.
baseline_probes: One unit on K2: one certain edge-deletion hop, zero explicit unit death and birth rates, default pruning.
One unit on one of two disconnected K2 components: same hop with relocation enabled; record whether it appears in the other component.
One isolated unit host plus separate K2: execute isolated-node fallback; record newly created cross-component edge.
circulation_endpoint: Fraction of hops covered by at least three consecutive laps of a simple cycle of length 3 through 6, following the direction of the first lap. Unit-hop histories only; node labels carry no meaning.

references.positive: Legal oriented laps on the same cycle; engineered instrument control, not emergent dynamics.
references.null: Independent unbiased neighbor hops on the same cycle with the same hop budget.
references.separation: Positive exceeds paired null on a one-sided exact sign test p <= 0.05, with positive median exceeding null median.
references.invariant_companion: Raw paired signs and exact binomial sign probability; repeat comparison after squaring coverage, a strictly increasing transform on [0,1].

verification: Analytic path fixtures: repeated simple cycles count; immediate backtracking and acyclic walks do not.
Node-renaming and full-history reversal preserve coverage.
Every calibration hop follows an edge of the declared control cycle.
Independent review of implementation and evidence; no whole-Documentation test scan.
negative_outcome: Baseline nonconformance is an implementation counterexample, not failure of the universe hypothesis. Unseparated references reject the instrument. No candidate result exists while the model representation is unresolved.
stop_rule: At most two attempts on one failure fingerprint; do not tune the endpoint using candidate results.
closure: Commit and push intended files; build public archive from pushed commit; verify static deployment and separate token-scoped RAG. Missing access is publication_blocked.
